dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Gray is at risk due to behavioral concerns. Gray has not acclimated well to the shelter enviornment and is only allowing for minimal handling. During her previous stay in care, Gray was observed to growl, bare teeth, and snarl when handlers approach then while in kennel. She had been seen playing with her toys in the kennel from a distance. During her recent stay in care, Gray was reported to growl and bite the leash during pickup and then began alligator rolling once secured. When handlers leash her, Gray has hard barked and snapped at leads, retreats towards the back of her kennel, and remains tense-bodied when interacting with handlers. She will accept high-value treats and has engaged in the treat/retreat game. But Grey has escalated to growling and snapping at staff during interactions when trying to engage with her. Medically, Gray has alopecia and recieved treatment for a chronic ear infection.

Gray initially arrived at the care center as a stray and was reclaimed, before being returned as a stray. Gray has not acclimated well to the kennel environment and has displayed highly fearful behavior, such as growling and lunging during attempts at medical examination, and hard barking and retreating to the back of her kennel when being leashed. In her previous stay, she was also observed to growl and snarl when attempting to remove her from her kennel. Once out of her kennel, she avoids interaction with handlers and seeks escape from the room. We recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
